about:
Zephyrus Electronics & Fabrication was founded in 1985 in Tulsa, Oklahoma, on a commitment to innovation, durability, and customer satisfaction. The company operates as a single integrated supplier for electronics and metal fabrication, combining design, assembly, and finishing under one roof.

The shop provides in-house PCB design and assembly, wire harness fabrication, and the manufacture of plastic, polycarbonate, and metal enclosures and brackets. Its metal fabrication facility runs a Strippit 1000xp 20 CNC turret punch, an AMADA 8025 NC press brake, Miller Syncrowave 300 welders, and a Timesaver 22 series deburring and finishing line. Engraving and silk‑screening capabilities include Gravograph IS7000/IS8000 engravers and an Epilog Laser Fusion system. Wire processing uses a Schleuniger Eco Strip 9380 cutter/stripper and Molex and AMP terminal presses.

Zephyrus serves OEM and industrial customers across a range of sectors, building custom control panels, complex wiring harnesses, and precision‑machined enclosures to specification. The company emphasizes rapid prototyping and quick turnaround on design changes to support product development cycles.

The firm’s stated differentiation is its integrated, one‑stop approach—streamlining production, reducing lead times, and ensuring quality from concept to completion—with all work performed in the United States.
